|------|-------|
| 1    | **C♯** |
| 2    | **D♯** |
| 3    | **E♯** *(enharmonically equivalent to F)* |
| 4    | **F♯** |
| 5    | **G♯** |
| 6    | **A♯** |
| 7    | **B♯** *(enharmonically equivalent to C)* |

So the full C♯ major scale consists of the pitches:

```
C♯ – D♯ – E♯ – F♯ – G♯ – A♯ – B♯
```
